correctness.rationale: The regular D_2n representation decomposes into 1D sign characters (sums of three ±1 never vanish) and paired 2D irreducibles. For pure-coset triples, a zero block requires three cube roots, equivalent to 3|q=n/g and distinct normalized residues modulo 3; exactly 2g Fourier frequencies give nullity 4g after regular multiplicity. For mixed triples the 2×2 determinant equals ±(1+2cos(2πkd/n)) and rank drops by one at the primitive cube roots, giving 2g nullity. Counting same-coset unordered pairs by additive order gives n²φ(q) mixed supports; primitive normalized difference pairs give the Euler-product pure counts; summation yields n²(n−m)+n³(1−3^(−2v))/12. Independently constructed real integer regular convolution matrices and compared their ranks and whole nullity histogram for EVERY triple for n=3,...,9 (not merely isolated examples), with exact agreement; the unrestricted conclusion rests on the representation/census proof, not numerical ranks.
